title: Flown Segment Bonus on Summit Choice-Benefit Miles
content:
**Question: does recent flying change a Crestline Summit Loyalty Program choice-benefit bonus credit?**

Yes. A flown-segment bonus follows the flight accrual entries posted on the membership in the last twelve months:

| Flight accrual entries posted in the last twelve months | Flown-segment bonus (miles) |
|---|---|
| 12 or more | 3000 |
| 6 up to fewer than 12 | 1500 |
| Fewer than 6 | None |

**Question: which entries are counted?** Flight accrual entries on the membership's activity, each posting counting once, whose posting date is fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the day the credit posts.

**Question: how is the bonus given?** As a fixed number of miles, set by the count of entries alone, added to the miles the credit carries.

**Boundary readings (hypothetical counts):** 11 entries give 1500 miles and 12 give 3000; 5 entries give nothing and 6 give 1500.
